title: Workerd pool's in-process tests still ride the quiet-host 30s defaults
body:
fim load-sized the node config's testTimeout/hookTimeout to 120s and bounded the workerd pool's full-Harness tests at 120s each, but vitest.config.ts (workerd) still carries 30s for its in-process tests: the storage-conformance cases (each a fresh Durable Object running migrations inside workerd) and the scripted-door env tests. No observed failure names them — the finding's synthetic 12x run covered the node suite, and the 30s there is justified for quiet 2-vCPU CI runners — but the same starvation argument that load-sized the node defaults applies to `pnpm test` on a loaded shared host. Worth its own evidence run (a synthetic-contention run of the workerd suite) before changing the defaults.
evidence: harness/vitest.config.ts (testTimeout: 30_000, hookTimeout: 30_000); harness/test/storage-conformance.test.ts (one DO instance per case)
